schema_scope: local research receipt, not a shared Blueprint schema
verdict_scope: Fictional seeded RSVP save/read/correction/recovery design only
independence: Separate read-only Operator workers, no author role or write permission; reviews are agent judgments, not human product acceptance. Final reviewer saw prior findings; this was not a blinded comparative experiment.
review_method: Read source requirements and handoff, check design against independent concerns, identify concrete failing cases, then review a hashed revision for closure and adjacent defects.
model_evidence: Policy selected gpt-5.6-terra/high; both runtime receipts report model and effort null. Actual model/effort unverified.

findings.problem: Recovery omitted the current scope/request versions needed for a new intent.
findings.resolution: Every current snapshot includes scope/data/request versions; new intent uses that exact snapshot.

findings.problem: Audit and receipt could lose the scope at save time when assignments changed.
findings.resolution: Immutable person, question, covered-event IDs and scope revision stored transactionally; historical source deletion restricted.
